description: A standardized method for calculating, documenting, and tracking risks is not established.
applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity risk management Enterprise governance and leadership functions Strategic planning and risk management teams Organizations subject to regulatory compliance requirements

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Look for inconsistent risk calculation methodologies, absence of risk scoring frameworks, missing risk categorization schemas, lack of standardized risk documentation templates, undefined prioritization criteria.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls
